description: Read a SimplePractice Client Portal through the simplepractice-mcp server — upcoming appointments, invoices/statements/superbills/receipts, balance and saved cards, paperwork waiting to be signed, and practice announcements. Use when the user asks about their therapy or healthcare appointments, what they owe a practice, a superbill for insurance, or forms their provider has sent them.
